title: Topic 3: Family & Relationships - Reading
description: Two short texts with three questions each.

readingBlock.readingText:
TEXT A - Photo caption / social post format
[Photo: four people]
My family! This is my mother, Vera, and my father, Joao.
The boy is my brother, Caio. He is 10 years old.
I love my family very much.
- Posted by Lara

TEXT B - Chat messages format
Nina: Is this your sister in the photo?
Gil:  No, she is not my sister. She is my friend Clara.
Nina: And the man? Is he your father?
Gil:  Yes! His name is Rui. He is 45.
